admission: Admit an entire civil-day trip only when every ordered stop pair matches its reviewed operator/line graph and no source call requires prior arrangement. Preserve every source call and external endpoint. All paths are inferred on undirected official alignments with bounded stop connectors, not direction-certified road routes or observed positions.
scopeLimits: Complete annual pinned GTFS census of trips with at least one source stop in the full SG polygon; not all six OSTWIND cantons.
Nonstopping through traffic, services absent from national GTFS and unscheduled/flexible products are outside the measured census.
Weekday and Sunday September fixtures include preceding-service-day spillover; winter, holidays and other seasonal dates remain unvalidated.
Only explicitly reviewed, bounded same-operator source-edge repairs; no invented road, water or mountain connectors.
Regional feed and source vectors remain local pending resolution of publisher redistribution terms.
